description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Payment and Settlement Systems Act, No. 28 of 2005, Money or Value Transfer Service Providers Regulations No.1 of 2024.
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Finance under the Payment and Settlement Systems Act, establishing a legal and regulatory framework for Money or Value Transfer Service Providers. It outlines registration requirements, operational rules, compliance obligations, and supervisory authority of the Central Bank, making it primarily about legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel, organizational changes, or other specialized categories.
